name: Vitruvia · Fuentes y método de recuperación

local_corpus.scope: Only the documents actually indexed. Manuscript images without verified text do not constitute a searchable transcription.

external_sources.Wikipedia: Encyclopedic context and attributed extracts. Not independent verification of every claim.
external_sources.Wikidata: Entity identification and linked metadata. Not a textual quotation.
external_sources.Crossref: Bibliographic metadata and DOI records. A record does not prove full-text access or peer review.
external_sources.Open Library and Google Books: Catalogue and book discovery. Academic status is not automatically certified.
external_sources.Institutional search buttons: External searches; results are not already read or collated by Vitruvia.

semantic_search.execution: visitor browser; explicitly selected AI mode
semantic_search.fallback: BM25 lexical results when the neural model cannot load
semantic_search.output: Retrieval of indexed source fragments; no newly generated translations or manuscript readings.

manuscript_evidence: Canonical locus, editorial paragraph and manuscript folio are different references; automatic alignment is not an independent collatio.
privacy: Visual imports and local PDFs retain their existing transient browser processing. This update introduces no persistent query history or file storage.
